q: Break that down by product and channel.

checks.what: tool: reuses prior scope (drilldown or same window)

answer:
Net sales are down modestly this week vs the prior week: ₹3,27,377 (2026-10-12..10-16, order-date, partial week) vs ₹3,58,502 (2026-10-07..10-11) — a fall of ₹31,125 (−8.7%). The drop is driven mostly by fewer orders and materially lower ad spend, concentrated on Meta and a handful of previously‑big products that dropped out of this week’s mix.

What changed (largest impacts first)
- Orders fell 273 → 210 (−63 orders, −23.1%), removing most of the volume the business sold last week. Fewer orders are the primary reason net sales are lower.  
- Ad spend fell sharply: ₹2,86,290 → ₹2,04,301 (−₹81,989, −28.6%). Lower spend reduces reach and likely explains part of the order loss; the spend shortfall is concentrated in paid channels.  
- Product mix shifts: several high‑value Meta product placements disappeared or collapsed vs the prior week — e.g. Meow Scratch Lounge (₹35,049 last week → disappeared, contribution to the gap 112.6%), Pawveralls Suspender Boots on Meta (₹37,550 → ₹6,239, −₹31,311) and PawTech Cleaner (₹23,203 → disappeared). These missing top sellers explain much of the sales decline.  
- New or increased sellers partly offset the loss (examples: Play Scratch Lounge, WildTrail Boots on Meta showed new/stronger sales), but not enough to cover the absent items.

Worth checking:
- Campaign-level activity on Meta (paused budgets, creative changes or delivery issues) for the disappeared products and the Pawveralls campaigns — these line up with the big drops by product+platform. Also confirm ad creative/status and budget changes the week before.
